```{r helpers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- OneDrive-resilient artefact writers -------------------------------------
# The output/ tree lives inside a OneDrive-synced folder. When OneDrive is
# syncing an existing artefact, a write to that file intermittently fails with
# "cannot open the connection" (gzfile). These wrappers shadow saveRDS()/ggsave()
# with a short retry loop so knitting is resilient to transient file locks.
.write_with_retry <- function(fun, path, ..., .tries = 8, .wait = 0.6) {
  for (attempt in seq_len(.tries)) {
    ok <- tryCatch({ fun(...); TRUE }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
    if (isTRUE(ok)) return(invisible(NULL))
    if (attempt == .tries) stop(ok, call. = FALSE)
    Sys.sleep(.wait)
  }
}
saveRDS <- function(object, file = "", ...) {
  .write_with_retry(function() base::saveRDS(object, file, ...), file)
}
ggsave <- function(filename, ...) {
  .write_with_retry(function() ggplot2::ggsave(filename, ...), filename)
}

  paste0(f(est), " (", f(lo), "\u2013", f(hi), ")")
}

# ---- WHO standard population (ages 20-95+) for ASMR -------------------------
full_who_std <- data.table(
  age    = 0:100,
  weight = c(
    rep(0.013, 10), rep(0.014, 10), rep(0.013, 10), rep(0.012, 10),
    rep(0.011, 10), rep(0.009, 10), rep(0.007, 10), rep(0.005, 10),
    rep(0.003, 10), rep(0.001, 10), 0.001
  )
)
who_std <- full_who_std[age >= 20 & age <= 94]
who_std <- rbind(
  who_std,
  data.table(age = 95, weight = full_who_std[age >= 95, sum(weight)])
)
who_std[, weight := weight / sum(weight)]

calculate_asmr <- function(dt, std_pop = who_std,
                            deaths_col = "deaths_dx",
                            population_col = "Nx",
                            disagg_var = "intervention") {
  dt <- copy(dt)
  dt[, age := as.integer(gsub("\\+", "", age))]
  dt <- merge(dt, std_pop, by = "age", all.x = TRUE)
  dt[, rate          := get(deaths_col) / get(population_col)]
  dt[, weighted_rate := rate * weight]
  group_vars <- c("year", disagg_var)
  dt[, .(ASMR = sum(weighted_rate, na.rm = TRUE) * 1e5), by = group_vars]
}

# ---- Deaths-delayed calculator -----------------------------------------------
deaths_summary <- function(dt,
                           baseline_label = "b.a.u",
                           by_cols = c("age_group", "sex", "year",
                                       "location", "cause", "age"),
                           value_col = "dead") {
  stopifnot(is.data.table(dt))
  n_interventions <- uniqueN(dt[intervention != baseline_label, intervention])
  baseline_cols   <- setdiff(by_cols, "intervention")
  baseline   <- dt[intervention == baseline_label,
                   .(baseline_deaths = sum(get(value_col), na.rm = TRUE)),
                   by = baseline_cols]
  nonbaseline <- dt[intervention != baseline_label,
                    .(deaths_projected = sum(get(value_col), na.rm = TRUE)),
                    by = by_cols]
  if (!("intervention" %in% by_cols))
    nonbaseline[, deaths_projected := deaths_projected / n_interventions]
  merged <- merge(nonbaseline, baseline, by = baseline_cols,
                  all.x = TRUE, allow.cartesian = TRUE)
  merged[, deaths_delayed     := baseline_deaths - deaths_projected]
  merged[, deaths_delayed_ave := deaths_delayed / 25]
  merged[, deaths_delayed_pct := deaths_delayed / baseline_deaths]
  merged[]
}
```

---

# Background

This report presents modelled projections of cardiovascular disease (CVD) mortality under
WHO-endorsed risk-factor control interventions aligned with four priority global targets.
The central research question is:

> *What would be the projected health impact --- in terms of deaths averted and
> life-years gained --- of achieving WHO targets for hypertension control and
> statin therapy coverage, applied simultaneously across `r n_countries` countries
> from 2026 to 2050 (with 2025 as the baseline year)?*

Four causes of CVD death are modelled jointly: ischemic heart disease (IHD), ischemic
stroke, intracerebral hemorrhage (hemorrhagic stroke), and hypertensive heart disease (HHD).
A discrete-time multi-state transition model (Well -> Sick -> Dead) is built from GBD 2023
data, calibrated to WHO Global Health Estimates 2023 cause-specific deaths (GBD 2023 deaths
where unavailable) and GBD 2023 prevalence, and projected forward to 2050 using UNWPP 2024
population estimates.

---

# WHO Priority Targets

The model evaluates progress toward four WHO priority cardiovascular targets:

| # | WHO Target | Modelled Intervention |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 150 million more people with hypertension under control by 2030 | **HTN Control (Combined):** additional control among hypertensives, split into mutually exclusive **no-diabetes** and **diabetes** subgroups |
| 2 | >=50% of eligible individuals receiving lipid-lowering therapy and counselling | **Improved Statin Uptake:** 50% statin coverage among eligible adults by 2030 |
| 3 | 80% blood pressure control among people with diagnosed diabetes | **HTN Control (Diabetes):** BP control among hypertensives *with* diabetes (0.80 aspirational ceiling by 2030) |
| 4 | 80% availability of validated automated blood pressure devices in public and private facilities | Operationally embedded in the HTN Control scenarios; enables Targets 1 and 3 |

Target 1 (150 million more controlled) is modelled as two **mutually exclusive and
exhaustive** subgroups of the hypertensive population, so a person with diabetes is
counted once, in the diabetes subgroup only:

* **HTN Control (No Diabetes)** --- antihypertensive scale-up among hypertensives
  **without** diabetes (subgroup-specific Ettehad effect sizes).
* **HTN Control (Diabetes)** --- BP control among hypertensives **with** diabetes,
  moving toward a 0.80 aspirational ceiling (diabetes-specific Ettehad effect sizes).
* **HTN Control (Combined)** --- both subgroups together; this is the scenario that
  delivers the **150-million** additional-controlled target and is the sum of the two
  subgroup contributions (there is no multiplicative cross-term between them).
* **Improved Statin Uptake** --- lipid-lowering therapy for eligible adults
  (50% coverage by 2030; affects IHD and ischemic stroke via an attributable-fraction approach).
* **All Interventions** --- BP subgroups + statins simultaneously.

Baseline control among hypertensives with diabetes is assumed 15 percentage points
higher than among those without, preserving the observed overall control rate
($c = (1-w_D)\,c_N + w_D\,c_D$, with $c_N = c - w_D(0.15)$ and $c_D = c + (1-w_D)(0.15)$).
The 150-million target is allocated between subgroups by a single shared proportional
scale-up (diabetes capped at 0.80, no-diabetes at 1.0) on the **fixed 2025 population**,
so the two subgroup additions sum to exactly 150 million.

## HTN Control Targets: 150 Million Additional Controlled, by Diabetes Status and WHO Region

```{r control-summary, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Build the control-target summary directly from the long scenario table written
# by code/04_define_interventions.R (scenario_id x location x sex x subgroup),
# joined to WHO region. All coverage rates and 2030 controlled counts use the
# FIXED 2025 population denominator, so the diabetes / no-diabetes additions sum
# to exactly 150 million. This object is saved to output/slides/ and reused
# verbatim by aim1_executive_slides.Rmd (no recomputation in the slides).

htn_tg <- fread(paste0(wd_data, "htn_control_targets_by_loc.csv"))
htn_tg <- merge(htn_tg, countries_dt[, .(location, region)],
                by = "location", all.x = TRUE)
n_region_unmapped <- htn_tg[is.na(region), uniqueN(location)]

scenario_lbl <- c(
  baseline            = "Baseline (business-as-usual)",
  bp_no_diabetes_only = "HTN Control (No Diabetes)",
  bp_diabetes_only    = "HTN Control (Diabetes)",
  bp_combined         = "HTN Control (Combined, 150M target)"
)
subgroup_lbl <- c(
  htn_no_diabetes = "Without diabetes",
  htn_diabetes    = "With diabetes",
  total           = "All hypertensives"
)

agg_control <- function(dt) {
  base <- dt[, .(
    htn_pop_2025    = sum(htn_population_2025),
    controlled_2025 = sum(controlled_2025),
    controlled_2030 = sum(controlled_2030),
    additional_2030 = sum(additional_controlled_2030)
  ), by = .(region, scenario_id, subgroup)]
  tot <- dt[, .(
    subgroup        = "total",
    htn_pop_2025    = sum(htn_population_2025),
    controlled_2025 = sum(controlled_2025),
    controlled_2030 = sum(controlled_2030),
    additional_2030 = sum(additional_controlled_2030)
  ), by = .(region, scenario_id)]
  rbind(base, tot)
}

control_summary <- rbind(
  agg_control(htn_tg[!is.na(region)]),
  agg_control(copy(htn_tg)[, region := "Global"])
)
control_summary[, `:=`(
  coverage_2025 = controlled_2025 / htn_pop_2025,
  coverage_2030 = controlled_2030 / htn_pop_2025,
  pct_increase  = fifelse(controlled_2025 > 0,
                          additional_2030 / controlled_2025 * 100, NA_real_),
  scenario_label = scenario_lbl[scenario_id],
  subgroup_label = subgroup_lbl[subgroup]
)]

# Split scalars for reuse (global bp_combined).
gcomb <- control_summary[region == "Global" & scenario_id == "bp_combined"]
add_no_diabetes <- gcomb[subgroup == "htn_no_diabetes", additional_2030]
add_diabetes    <- gcomb[subgroup == "htn_diabetes",    additional_2030]
add_total       <- gcomb[subgroup == "total",           additional_2030]

# QA: the two subgroups must sum to exactly 150 million on the fixed 2025 pop.
stopifnot(
  "diabetes + no-diabetes additions must equal 150M" =
    abs((add_no_diabetes + add_diabetes) - 150e6) <= 1,
  "total-subgroup additional must equal 150M" =
    abs(add_total - 150e6) <= 1
)

# Persist the reusable objects for the slides.
slides_dir <- paste0(wd_outp, "slides/")
if (!dir.exists(slides_dir)) dir.create(slides_dir, recursive = TRUE)
saveRDS(control_summary, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_control_summary.rds"))
sl_control_scalars <- list(
  target_total          = 150e6,
  add_total             = add_total,
  add_no_diabetes       = add_no_diabetes,
  add_diabetes          = add_diabetes,
  share_no_diabetes     = add_no_diabetes / add_total,
  share_diabetes        = add_diabetes / add_total,
  n_region_unmapped     = n_region_unmapped
)
saveRDS(sl_control_scalars, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_control_scalars.rds"))
message("Control-target summary saved: sl_control_summary.rds, sl_control_scalars.rds")

# ---- Display helper ---------------------------------------------------------
control_disp <- function(dt, group_col, group_name) {
  d <- copy(dt)
  setnames(d, group_col, "Group")
  out <- d[, .(
    Group,
    `Target population 2025`      = comma(htn_pop_2025,    accuracy = 1),
    `Controlled 2025 (n)`         = comma(controlled_2025, accuracy = 1),
    `Coverage 2025`               = percent(coverage_2025, accuracy = 0.1),
    `Controlled 2030 (n)`         = comma(controlled_2030, accuracy = 1),
    `Coverage 2030`               = percent(coverage_2030, accuracy = 0.1),
    `Additional controlled 2030`  = comma(additional_2030, accuracy = 1),
    `% increase vs baseline`      = ifelse(is.na(pct_increase), "—",
                                           percent(pct_increase / 100, accuracy = 0.1))
  )]
  setnames(out, "Group", group_name)
  out[]
}
```

Of the **`r comma(add_total, accuracy = 1)`** additional people with hypertension
controlled by 2030, **`r comma(add_no_diabetes, accuracy = 1)`**
(`r percent(add_no_diabetes / add_total, accuracy = 0.1)`) are **without diabetes** and
**`r comma(add_diabetes, accuracy = 1)`**
(`r percent(add_diabetes / add_total, accuracy = 0.1)`) are **with diabetes**, summing to
exactly 150 million on the fixed 2025 population baseline.

`r if (n_region_unmapped > 0) paste0("*Note: ", n_region_unmapped, " location(s) could not be mapped to a WHO region and are included in the Global total only.*") else ""`

### Combined scenario (150M target), by WHO region **and** diabetes subgroup

This table and figure disaggregate the 150-million target **both** ways: by WHO region
and, within each region, by the mutually exclusive no-diabetes / diabetes subgroups, with
a subtotal ("All hypertensives") for each region and a Global block. Regional totals sum
to 150 million, and so do the two subgroup totals (83.8 M without + 66.2 M with diabetes).

```{r control-summary-region-subgroup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
sub_levels <- c("htn_no_diabetes", "htn_diabetes", "total")
rs <- control_summary[scenario_id == "bp_combined" & region %in% region_order]
rs[, region   := factor(region, levels = region_order)]
rs[, subgroup := factor(subgroup, levels = sub_levels)]
setorder(rs, region, subgroup)
rs_disp <- rs[, .(
  `WHO region`                 = as.character(region),
  Subgroup                     = subgroup_lbl[as.character(subgroup)],
  `Target population 2025`     = comma(htn_pop_2025,    accuracy = 1),
  `Controlled 2025 (n)`        = comma(controlled_2025, accuracy = 1),
  `Coverage 2025`              = percent(coverage_2025, accuracy = 0.1),
  `Controlled 2030 (n)`        = comma(controlled_2030, accuracy = 1),
  `Coverage 2030`              = percent(coverage_2030, accuracy = 0.1),
  `Additional controlled 2030` = comma(additional_2030, accuracy = 1),
  `% increase vs baseline`     = percent(pct_increase / 100, accuracy = 0.1)
)]
kable(rs_disp,
      caption = paste0("HTN Control (Combined, 150M target) by WHO region AND diabetes ",
                       "subgroup, on the fixed 2025 hypertensive population."),
      align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 7))) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  row_spec(which(rs$subgroup == "total"), italic = TRUE) |>
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top")
```

```{r control-summary-region-fig, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=5.5}
fig_dat <- control_summary[scenario_id == "bp_combined" &
                           subgroup %in% c("htn_no_diabetes", "htn_diabetes") &
                           region != "Global"]
fig_dat[, subgroup_lbl := factor(
  fifelse(subgroup == "htn_no_diabetes", "Without diabetes", "With diabetes"),
  levels = c("Without diabetes", "With diabetes"))]
reg_ord <- fig_dat[, .(tot = sum(additional_2030)), by = region][order(tot), region]
fig_dat[, region := factor(region, levels = reg_ord)]
reg_tot <- fig_dat[, .(tot = sum(additional_2030) / 1e6), by = region]

g <- ggplot(fig_dat, aes(x = additional_2030 / 1e6, y = region, fill = subgroup_lbl)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = reg_tot, aes(x = tot, y = region, label = sprintf("%.1f", tot)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.15, size = 3.6) +

  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.10))) +
  labs(
    title = "150 Million Additional BP-Controlled by 2030\nby WHO Region and Diabetes Status",
    subtitle = paste0("Fixed 2025 population | global total ", fmt_m(add_total),
                      " M (", fmt_m(add_no_diabetes), " M without + ",
                      fmt_m(add_diabetes), " M with diabetes)"),
    x = "Additional people controlled (millions)", y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(g)
ggsave(paste0(wd_outp, "aim1_control_region_split.png"), plot = g,
```

# Projected Deaths Averted (2026-2050)

All cumulative deaths-averted totals below are summed over 2026--2050. The year 2025 is
the baseline year: it is shown in the time-series figures as the starting reference
point, but it is excluded from every cumulative total.

```{r compute-deaths-averted, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Core: deaths delayed by intervention x year ----------------------------
# Built from the 2025 baseline year so the time series can show it; every
# cumulative quantity is restricted to year >= cum_start_year (2026).
dt_base <- data.out[intervention == "b.a.u" & year >= baseline_year,
                    .(baseline_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                    by = .(age_group, sex, year, location, cause, age)]

dt_nonbase <- data.out[intervention != "b.a.u" & year >= baseline_year,
                       .(dead = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                       by = .(age_group, sex, year, location, cause, age, intervention)]

dt_merged_all <- merge(dt_nonbase, dt_base,
                       by = c("age_group", "sex", "year", "location", "cause", "age"),
                       all.x = TRUE)
dt_merged_all[, deaths_delayed := baseline_deaths - dead]

# Accumulation window (2026-2050): used for all totals, tables and bar charts.
dt_merged <- dt_merged_all[year >= cum_start_year]

# ---- Cumulative totals (2026-2050) --------------------------------------------
dt_cumul <- dt_merged[, .(deaths_delayed = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                       by = intervention]

# ---- Annual time-series ------------------------------------------------------
# Keeps the 2025 baseline year as the first point; the running total is 0 in
# 2025 and accumulates from 2026.
dt_annual <- dt_merged_all[, .(deaths_delayed = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                            by = .(intervention, year)]
dt_annual[, intervention := factor(intervention, levels = int_order)]
setorder(dt_annual, intervention, year)
dt_annual[, cum_deaths_delayed := cumsum(fifelse(year >= cum_start_year, deaths_delayed, 0)),
          by = intervention]

# ---- Per-scenario totals for inline text ------------------------------------
total_all  <- dt_cumul[intervention == "All Interventions",      deaths_delayed]
total_bp   <- dt_cumul[intervention == "HTN Control (No Diabetes)",  deaths_delayed]
total_bpd  <- dt_cumul[intervention == "HTN Control (Diabetes)", deaths_delayed]
total_stat <- dt_cumul[intervention == "Improved Statin Uptake", deaths_delayed]
```

Between 2026 and 2050, achieving all three intervention targets simultaneously is
projected to avert approximately **`r fmt_m(total_all)` million deaths** globally.
HTN control in the general population (WHO Target 1) would avert
`r fmt_m(total_bp)` million deaths; targeting BP control specifically in people with
diabetes (WHO Target 3) would avert `r fmt_m(total_bpd)` million deaths.
Scale-up of lipid-lowering therapy (WHO Target 2) would avert an additional
`r fmt_m(total_stat)` million deaths.

## Table 1 --- Cumulative Deaths Averted by Intervention (2026-2050)

```{r table1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
tab1 <- copy(dt_cumul)
tab1 <- tab1[intervention != "b.a.u"]
tab1[, intervention := factor(intervention, levels = int_order)]
setorder(tab1, intervention)

tab1[, deaths_M      := round(deaths_delayed / 1e6, 2)]
tab1[, deaths_annual := round(deaths_delayed / 25 / 1e3, 1)]

tab1[, who_target := fcase(
  intervention == "HTN Control (No Diabetes)",
    "Target 1 (no-diabetes subgroup of the 150M split)",
  intervention == "HTN Control (Diabetes)",
    "Target 3: BP control in people with diabetes (0.80 ceiling); diabetes subgroup of the 150M split",
  intervention == "Improved Statin Uptake",
    "Target 2: >=50% eligible adults on lipid-lowering therapy by 2030",
  intervention == "All Interventions",
    "All WHO targets (1+2+3) combined",
  default = ""
)]

tab1_fmt <- tab1[, .(
  Intervention       = intervention,
  WHO_Target         = who_target,
  Deaths_averted_M   = comma(deaths_M,      accuracy = 0.01),
  Avg_per_year_thou  = comma(deaths_annual, accuracy = 0.1)
)]
setnames(tab1_fmt,
         old = c("WHO_Target", "Deaths_averted_M", "Avg_per_year_thou"),
         new = c("WHO Target",
                 "Deaths averted (M, 2026\u20132050)",
                 "Average per year (thousands)"))

kable(tab1_fmt,
      caption = "Table 1. Cumulative deaths averted (2026\u20132050) by intervention scenario.",
      align   = "llrr") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "7cm") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "9cm") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(general = paste0(
    "Deaths averted = deaths in business-as-usual scenario minus deaths under each intervention, ",
    "summed over 2026\u20132050 (2025 = baseline year, excluded). ",
    "Causes: ischemic heart disease, ischemic stroke, intracerebral hemorrhage, ",
    "hypertensive heart disease."
  ))

dt_excel_tab1 <- copy(tab1_fmt)
```

## Figure 4b --- Cumulative Deaths Averted Over Time by Region (All Interventions)

Cumulative deaths averted over time (2026--2050) under the combined all-interventions
scenario, with one line per WHO region. The series starts at the 2025 baseline year,
where the cumulative total is zero.

```{r figure4b-cumulative-region, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
who_region_levels <- c("Africa", "Americas", "Eastern Mediterranean",
                       "Europe", "South-East Asia", "Western Pacific")

# Region x year deaths averted under the combined scenario (All Interventions),
# then cumulated over time within each WHO region. 2025 (baseline year) is kept
# as the first point but excluded from the running total, which starts in 2026.
reg_base <- data.out[intervention == "b.a.u" & year >= baseline_year,
                     .(baseline_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                     by = .(region, year)]
reg_int  <- data.out[intervention == "All Interventions" & year >= baseline_year,
                     .(deaths_projected = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                     by = .(region, year)]

dt_region_annual <- merge(reg_int, reg_base, by = c("region", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
dt_region_annual <- dt_region_annual[region %in% who_region_levels]
dt_region_annual[, deaths_delayed := baseline_deaths - deaths_projected]
setorder(dt_region_annual, region, year)
dt_region_annual[, cum_deaths_delayed := cumsum(fifelse(year >= cum_start_year, deaths_delayed, 0)),
                 by = region]
dt_region_annual[, region := factor(region, levels = who_region_levels)]

g <- ggplot(dt_region_annual,
            aes(x = year, y = cum_deaths_delayed / 1e6, color = region)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title    = "Cumulative Deaths Averted Over Time by Region, 2026–2050",
    subtitle = "All Interventions combined; 2025 = baseline year, deaths averted accumulate from 2026",
    x        = "Year",
    y        = "Cumulative deaths averted (millions)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))
print(g)
ggsave(paste0(wd_outp, "aim1_fig7_cum_region.png"), plot = g,
       width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r asmr-interventions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
```

# Burden of Disease Results

This section presents burden of disease estimates --- including deaths averted, years of life lost (YLLs) averted, years lived with disability (YLDs) averted, and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) averted --- for each intervention scenario over the period 2026--2050. All "averted" values are computed as the difference between the business-as-usual scenario and each intervention scenario, cumulated across years.

```{r load-dalys, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ---- Load DALYs output from 07_output_dalys.R --------------------------------
dt_dalys <- readRDS(paste0(wd_outp, "dt_output_dalys.rds"))
setDT(dt_dalys)

# Compatibility relabel: 07_output_dalys.R currently maps the no-diabetes BP
# subgroup to "HTN Control (General)". Align it with the current scenario label so
# the burden-of-disease tables below match int_order. (07_output_dalys.R is a
# pipeline script outside this reporting refactor; once it is updated to emit the
# new labels this line becomes a harmless no-op. NOTE: the "All Interventions"
# DALY rows also require 07 to recognise the new combined-intervention label —
# see the follow-up note in the completion report.)
dt_dalys[intervention == "HTN Control (General)",
         intervention := "HTN Control (No Diabetes)"]

# ---- Merge country metadata for WHO region and income group -------------------
dt_dalys <- merge(dt_dalys,
                  countries_dt[, .(location, region, location_income)],
                  by = "location", all.x = TRUE)

# ---- Compute baseline values per cell ----------------------------------------
# Accumulation window 2026-2050 (07 already writes year >= 2026; restated here).
daly_base <- dt_dalys[intervention == "b.a.u" & year >= cum_start_year,
                      .(base_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE),
                        base_yll    = sum(yll, na.rm = TRUE),
                        base_yld    = sum(yld, na.rm = TRUE),
                        base_daly   = sum(daly, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      by = .(location, cause, year)]

daly_int <- dt_dalys[intervention != "b.a.u" & year >= cum_start_year,
                     .(deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE),
                       yll    = sum(yll, na.rm = TRUE),
                       yld    = sum(yld, na.rm = TRUE),
                       daly   = sum(daly, na.rm = TRUE)),
                     by = .(location, cause, year, intervention)]

dt_bod <- merge(daly_int, daly_base, by = c("location", "cause", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
dt_bod[, `:=`(deaths_averted = base_deaths - deaths,
              yll_averted    = base_yll    - yll,
              yld_averted    = base_yld    - yld,
              daly_averted   = base_daly   - daly)]

# Merge region and income group onto the differenced data
dt_bod <- merge(dt_bod,
                countries_dt[, .(location, region, location_income)],
                by = "location", all.x = TRUE)
```

## Table --- Burden of Disease Averted by Intervention Scenario

Cumulative 2026--2050 deaths, YLLs, YLDs, and DALYs averted by intervention scenario, relative to business-as-usual.

```{r bod-table1, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
bod_tab1 <- dt_bod[, .(Deaths  = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE),
                       YLLs    = sum(yll_averted,    na.rm = TRUE),
                       YLDs    = sum(yld_averted,    na.rm = TRUE),
                       DALYs   = sum(daly_averted,   na.rm = TRUE)),
                   by = intervention]
bod_tab1[, intervention := factor(intervention, levels = int_order)]
setorder(bod_tab1, intervention)

bod_tab1_fmt <- copy(bod_tab1)
bod_tab1_fmt[, Deaths := fmt_m(Deaths)]
bod_tab1_fmt[, YLLs   := fmt_m(YLLs)]
bod_tab1_fmt[, YLDs   := fmt_m(YLDs)]
bod_tab1_fmt[, DALYs  := fmt_m(DALYs)]
setnames(bod_tab1_fmt, "intervention", "Intervention")

kable(bod_tab1_fmt,
      caption = "Cumulative burden of disease averted (millions, 2026\u20132050) by intervention scenario.",
      align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(general = "Values in millions. Averted = business-as-usual minus intervention scenario.")
```

## Table --- Burden of Disease Averted by Intervention Scenario and Cause

Cumulative 2026--2050 deaths and DALYs averted by intervention scenario and cause, with percentage contribution of each cause to total reduction within each scenario.

```{r bod-table2, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
bod_tab2 <- dt_bod[, .(Deaths  = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE),
                       YLLs    = sum(yll_averted,    na.rm = TRUE),
                       YLDs    = sum(yld_averted,    na.rm = TRUE),
                       DALYs   = sum(daly_averted,   na.rm = TRUE)),
                   by = .(intervention, cause)]
bod_tab2[, intervention := factor(intervention, levels = int_order)]

# Compute % contribution within each scenario
bod_tab2[, pct_deaths := Deaths / sum(Deaths) * 100, by = intervention]
bod_tab2[, pct_dalys  := DALYs  / sum(DALYs)  * 100, by = intervention]

bod_tab2[, cause_lbl := fcase(
  cause == "ihd",     "Ischemic heart disease",
  cause == "istroke", "Ischemic stroke",
  cause == "hstroke", "Intracerebral hemorrhage",
  cause == "hhd",     "Hypertensive heart disease",
  default = cause
)]
setorder(bod_tab2, intervention, cause)

bod_tab2_fmt <- bod_tab2[, .(
  Intervention        = intervention,
  Cause               = cause_lbl,
  Deaths              = fmt_m(Deaths),
  YLLs                = fmt_m(YLLs),
  YLDs                = fmt_m(YLDs),
  DALYs               = fmt_m(DALYs),
  `% Deaths`          = paste0(round(pct_deaths, 1), "%"),
  `% DALYs`           = paste0(round(pct_dalys,  1), "%")
)]

kable(bod_tab2_fmt,
      caption = "Cumulative burden of disease averted (millions, 2026\u20132050) by intervention and cause.",
      align = c("l", "l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 12) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) |>
  footnote(general = paste0(
    "Values in millions. % columns show each cause\u2019s share of the total reduction ",
    "within that intervention scenario."
  ))
```

# Excel Export

```{r excel-export, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
wb <- createWorkbook()

add_sheet <- function(wb, sheet_name, dat, title_str) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, title_str, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  addStyle(wb, sheet_name,
           style = createStyle(fontSize = 12, textDecoration = "bold"),
           rows = 1, cols = 1)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, dat, startRow = 3, startCol = 1,
            headerStyle = createStyle(textDecoration = "bold",
                                      fgFill = "#2E75B6", fontColour = "white",
                                      border = "Bottom"))
  setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(dat)), widths = "auto")
}

add_sheet(wb, "T1_Deaths_by_Intervention", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab1),
          "Table 1. Cumulative deaths averted (2026-2050) by intervention scenario.")
add_sheet(wb, "T2_Deaths_by_Cause", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab2),
          "Table 2. Deaths averted (millions, 2026-2050) by intervention and cause of death.")
add_sheet(wb, "T3_Deaths_by_Age", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab3),
          "Table 3. Deaths averted (2026-2050) by age group and intervention.")
add_sheet(wb, "T4_Deaths_by_Country", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab4),
          "Table 4. Country-level deaths averted (All Interventions, 2026-2050).")

if (exists("dt_excel_tab5") && nrow(dt_excel_tab5) > 0)
  add_sheet(wb, "T5_Deaths_by_Region", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab5),
            "Table 5. Deaths averted by region (All Interventions, 2026-2050).")

out_xlsx <- paste0(wd_scen, "aim1_results_tables.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
message("Tables exported to: ", out_xlsx)
```

# SLIDE DECK OUTPUTS
# Single source of truth for aim1_executive_slides.Rmd
# Runs after all prior sections; all key objects (dt_merged, dt_annual, dt_cumul,
# asmr_int, dt_tab4, dt_tab5, total_all, total_bp, total_bpd, total_stat) are
# already in the environment. Writes to output/slides/.

```{r slides-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
slides_dir <- paste0(wd_outp, "slides/")
if (!dir.exists(slides_dir)) dir.create(slides_dir, recursive = TRUE)
message("Slide artefacts will be written to: ", slides_dir)
```

```{r slides-scalars, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# SL-01: Scalar bundle — all inline `r` values the slides need
bau_total_deaths <- data.out[intervention == "b.a.u" & year >= cum_start_year,
                              sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)]
sl_scalars <- list(
  n_countries      = n_countries,
  study_years      = study_years,
  total_all        = total_all,
  total_bp         = total_bp,
  total_bpd        = total_bpd,
  total_stat       = total_stat,
  bau_total_deaths = bau_total_deaths
)
saveRDS(sl_scalars, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_scalars.rds"))
message("SL-01 saved: sl_scalars.rds")
```

```{r slides-tab-summary, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# SL-02: Cumulative summary table with formatted display columns
sl_tab_summary <- copy(dt_cumul)[intervention != "b.a.u"]
sl_tab_summary[, pct    := deaths_delayed / bau_total_deaths * 100]
sl_tab_summary[, cum_M  := paste0(fmt_M(deaths_delayed), " M")]
sl_tab_summary[, avg_yr := paste0(fmt_M(deaths_delayed / 25), " M")]
sl_tab_summary[, pct_s  := paste0(round(pct, 1), "%")]
sl_tab_summary[, intervention := factor(intervention, levels = int_order)]
setorder(sl_tab_summary, intervention)
saveRDS(sl_tab_summary, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_tab_summary.rds"))
message("SL-02 saved: sl_tab_summary.rds")
```

```{r slides-fig-baseline-trend, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# SL-09: Baseline disease trend PNG (slide-optimised dimensions)
dt_trend_sl <- data.out[intervention == "b.a.u" & year >= 2019,
                         .(new_cases = sum(newcases, na.rm = TRUE),
                           sick      = sum(sick,     na.rm = TRUE)),
                         by = year]
dt_melt_sl  <- melt(dt_trend_sl, id.vars = "year",
                    measure.vars  = c("new_cases", "sick"),
                    variable.name = "metric", value.name = "count")
dt_melt_sl[, metric_lbl := fifelse(metric == "new_cases",
                                    "Incident cases", "Prevalent cases")]

g_trend <- ggplot(dt_melt_sl,
                   aes(x = year, y = count / 1e6,
                       color = metric_lbl, linetype = year > 2019)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Incident cases"  = "steelblue",
                                "Prevalent cases" = "tomato"), name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "dashed"),
                        guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Persons (millions)",
       subtitle = "Solid = calibration; dashed = projection") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9))
ggsave(paste0(slides_dir, "sl_fig_baseline_trend.png"), plot = g_trend,
       width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 200)
message("SL-09 saved: sl_fig_baseline_trend.png")
```

```{r slides-econ, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# SL-ECON: Economic-valuation artefacts for the executive deck.
# Consumes outputs of code/08_economic_value_calculation.R:
#   - 08_vsl_summary_table_e1_2_primary.rds   (region × scenario, primary VSL)
#   - 08_vsly_summary_table_e1_2_primary.rds  (region × scenario, primary VSLY)
#   - 08_vsl_vsly_summary_table_appended.rds  (all four VSL/VSLY × elasticity blocks)
#
# Builds:
#   - sl_econ_vsl_primary  — display table of cumulative regional VSL share of GNI
#   - sl_econ_vsly_primary — same for VSLY (the headline metric)
#   - sl_econ_dotplot.png  — VSL/VSLY share-of-income dot plot (was in 08_*.R)
#   - sl_econ_scalars      — World VSLY share of income, primary, cumulative
#
# Mapping of model scenario codes → executive labels mirrors int_labels above.

econ_files <- c(
  vsl_prim  = paste0(wd_outp, "08_vsl_summary_table_e1_2_primary.rds"),
  vsly_prim = paste0(wd_outp, "08_vsly_summary_table_e1_2_primary.rds"),
  appended  = paste0(wd_outp, "08_vsl_vsly_summary_table_appended.rds")
)
econ_ok <- all(file.exists(econ_files))

if (econ_ok) {

  econ_scen_lbl <- c(
    bp_no_diabetes_only = "HTN Control (No Diabetes)",
    bp_only             = "HTN Control (No Diabetes)",  # alias for older econ files
    bp_diabetes_only    = "HTN Control (Diabetes)",
    statins_only        = "Improved Statin Uptake",
    all_interventions   = "All Interventions"
  )

  # ---- Region × scenario tables (primary, e1_2) ----------------------------
  build_econ_tab <- function(path) {
    dt <- as.data.table(readRDS(path))
    dt <- dt[scenario %in% names(econ_scen_lbl)]
    dt[, intervention := factor(econ_scen_lbl[scenario],
                                levels = int_order)]
    setorder(dt, intervention, who_region)
    dt
  }

  sl_econ_vsl_primary  <- build_econ_tab(econ_files[["vsl_prim"]])
  sl_econ_vsly_primary <- build_econ_tab(econ_files[["vsly_prim"]])

  saveRDS(sl_econ_vsl_primary,  paste0(slides_dir, "sl_econ_vsl_primary.rds"))
  saveRDS(sl_econ_vsly_primary, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_econ_vsly_primary.rds"))

  # ---- Headline scalar: World VSLY share of income (cumulative, all four) --
  world_vsly_all <- sl_econ_vsly_primary[
    who_region == "World" & intervention == "All Interventions"
  ]
  world_vsl_all  <- sl_econ_vsl_primary[
    who_region == "World" & intervention == "All Interventions"
  ]

  sl_econ_scalars <- list(
    world_vsly_share_total = if (nrow(world_vsly_all)) world_vsly_all$share_total else NA_real_,
    world_vsl_share_total  = if (nrow(world_vsl_all))  world_vsl_all$share_total  else NA_real_,
    world_vsly_value_total = if (nrow(world_vsly_all)) world_vsly_all$metric_total else NA_real_,
    world_vsl_value_total  = if (nrow(world_vsl_all))  world_vsl_all$metric_total  else NA_real_,
    base_year              = 2026L,
    horizon_end            = 2050L,
    elasticity_primary     = "Differential (e=0.8 HIC / 1.2 LMIC), Robinson et al. 2019",
    discount_rate          = 0.03
  )
  saveRDS(sl_econ_scalars, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_econ_scalars.rds"))

  # ---- Dot plot: VSL/VSLY share of income, by region × period ---------------
  dt_app <- as.data.table(readRDS(econ_files[["appended"]]))
  dt_app <- dt_app[scenario %in% names(econ_scen_lbl)]
  dt_app[, intervention := factor(econ_scen_lbl[scenario], levels = int_order)]

  share_cols <- grep("^share_", names(dt_app), value = TRUE)

  sl_econ_dotplot_dt <- melt(
    dt_app,
    id.vars       = c("valuation_type", "elasticity_case", "who_region",
                      "scenario", "intervention"),
    measure.vars  = share_cols,
    variable.name = "period",
    value.name    = "share_income"
  )

  sl_econ_dotplot_dt[, period := fcase(
    period == "share_2026",  "2026",
    period == "share_2030",  "2030",
    period == "share_2040",  "2040",
    period == "share_2050",  "2050",
    period == "share_total", "2026\u20132050\n(cumulative)",
    default = as.character(period)
  )]
  sl_econ_dotplot_dt[, period := factor(period,
    levels = c("2026", "2030", "2040", "2050", "2026\u20132050\n(cumulative)")
  )]
  sl_econ_dotplot_dt[, elasticity_label := fcase(
    elasticity_case == "e1_2_primary",     "Primary (e = 0.8/1.2)",
    elasticity_case == "e1_5_sensitivity", "Sensitivity (e = 1.5)",
    default = elasticity_case
  )]

  saveRDS(sl_econ_dotplot_dt, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_econ_dotplot_dt.rds"))

g_econ_dot <- ggplot(
  sl_econ_dotplot_dt[valuation_type == "VSLY"],  # keep only VSLY
  aes(x = share_income, y = intervention,
      colour = elasticity_label)
) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.55)) +
  facet_grid(who_region ~ period, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    name   = "Elasticity case",
    values = c("Primary (e = 0.8/1.2)" = "#2166ac",
               "Sensitivity (e = 1.5)" = "#d6604d")
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Economic value of avoidable CVD mortality, proportion of regional income",
    subtitle = "VSLY only | Discounted at r = 3% (Robinson et al. 2019)",
    x        = "Proportion of discounted GNI",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    strip.text.y       = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.x       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "#f0f0f0", colour = "grey70"),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.box         = "horizontal",
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(paste0(slides_dir, "sl_econ_dotplot.png"),
       plot = g_econ_dot, width = 11, height = 6.2, dpi = 220)
  message("SL-ECON saved: sl_econ_vsl_primary.rds, sl_econ_vsly_primary.rds, ",
          "sl_econ_scalars.rds, sl_econ_dotplot_dt.rds, sl_econ_dotplot.png")
} else {
  warning("Economic-valuation inputs not found in ", wd_outp,
          " — skipping SL-ECON artefacts. Run code/08_economic_value_calculation.R first.")
}
```

```{r slides-manifest, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# SL-16: Artefact manifest — printed in HTML report for traceability
sl_manifest <- data.table(
  file = c(
    "sl_scalars.rds", "sl_tab_summary.rds", "sl_tab_region.rds",
    "sl_tab_top15.rds", "sl_dt_cause.rds", "sl_dt_age.rds",
    "sl_dt_asmr.rds", "sl_dt_annual.rds",
    "sl_fig_baseline_trend.png", "sl_fig_asmr.png",
    "sl_fig_deaths_averted.png", "sl_fig_by_cause.png",
    "sl_fig_by_age.png", "sl_fig_top15_countries.png",
    "sl_fig_cum_averted.png",
    "sl_econ_vsl_primary.rds", "sl_econ_vsly_primary.rds",
    "sl_econ_scalars.rds", "sl_econ_dotplot_dt.rds",
    "sl_econ_dotplot.png"
  ),
  type = c(rep("rds", 8), rep("png", 7), rep("rds", 4), "png"),
  consumed_by = c(
    "inline scalars", "tab-summary kable", "tab-region kable",
    "fig-top-countries ggplot", "fig-by-cause ggplot", "fig-by-age ggplot",
    "fig-asmr ggplot", "fig-deaths-averted ggplot",
    "fig-baseline-trend include_graphics", "fig-asmr include_graphics (fallback)",
    "fig-deaths-averted include_graphics (fallback)",
    "fig-by-cause include_graphics (fallback)",
    "fig-by-age include_graphics (fallback)",
    "fig-top-countries include_graphics (fallback)",
    "fig-cum-averted include_graphics",
    "econ-regional-table kable",
    "econ-regional-table kable (VSLY headline)",
    "inline scalars (world VSLY share)",
    "econ-dotplot ggplot (alt source)",
    "econ-dotplot include_graphics"
  )
)
saveRDS(sl_manifest, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_manifest.rds"))

kable(sl_manifest,
      caption = "Slide deck artefact manifest. All files written to output/slides/.",
      col.names = c("File", "Type", "Consumed by (slides chunk)")) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 11) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

message(sprintf("SLIDE DECK OUTPUTS complete. %d artefacts written to %s",
                nrow(sl_manifest), slides_dir))
```

```{r paper-scalars, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Cause-specific deaths averted (All Interventions) ----------------------
cause_averted_all <- dt_merged[intervention == "All Interventions",
                                .(averted = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                by = cause]

# ---- Cause-specific deaths averted by intervention --------------------------
cause_averted_bp <- dt_merged[intervention == "HTN Control (No Diabetes)",
                               .(averted = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                               by = cause]
cause_averted_bpd <- dt_merged[intervention == "HTN Control (Diabetes)",
                                .(averted = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                by = cause]
cause_averted_stat <- dt_merged[intervention == "Improved Statin Uptake",
                                 .(averted = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                 by = cause]

# ---- BAU cause-specific deaths -----------------------------------------------
bau_by_cause <- data.out[intervention == "b.a.u" & year >= cum_start_year,
                          .(bau_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                          by = cause]

# ---- Percent of BAU averted --------------------------------------------------
pct_all  <- round(total_all  / bau_total_deaths * 100, 1)
pct_bp   <- round(total_bp   / bau_total_deaths * 100, 1)
pct_bpd  <- round(total_bpd  / bau_total_deaths * 100, 1)
pct_stat <- round(total_stat / bau_total_deaths * 100, 1)

# ---- Annual deaths averted at key timepoints ---------------------------------
annual_2030_all <- dt_annual[intervention == "All Interventions" & year == 2030,
                              deaths_delayed]
annual_2050_all <- dt_annual[intervention == "All Interventions" & year == 2050,
                              deaths_delayed]
annual_2030_bp  <- dt_annual[intervention == "HTN Control (No Diabetes)" & year == 2030,
                              deaths_delayed]
annual_2050_bp  <- dt_annual[intervention == "HTN Control (No Diabetes)" & year == 2050,
                              deaths_delayed]
annual_2030_stat <- dt_annual[intervention == "Improved Statin Uptake" & year == 2030,
                               deaths_delayed]
annual_2050_stat <- dt_annual[intervention == "Improved Statin Uptake" & year == 2050,
                               deaths_delayed]

# ---- Age-group totals (All Interventions) ------------------------------------
age_averted_all <- dt_merged[intervention == "All Interventions",
                              .(averted = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                              by = age_group]

# ---- Sex totals (All Interventions) ------------------------------------------
sex_averted_all <- dt_merged[intervention == "All Interventions",
                              .(averted = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                              by = sex]

# ---- Top 5 countries (All Interventions) -------------------------------------
top5_countries <- dt_tab4[order(-deaths_delayed)][1:min(5, .N)]

# ---- Region totals (All Interventions) from dt_tab5 --------------------------
# dt_tab5 already computed above

# ---- Income group totals (All Interventions) from BOD data -------------------
income_averted_all <- dt_bod[intervention == "All Interventions",
                              .(deaths_averted = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE),
                                daly_averted   = sum(daly_averted,   na.rm = TRUE)),
                              by = location_income]
income_order <- c("Low income", "Lower-middle income", "Upper-middle income", "High income")
income_averted_all[, location_income := factor(location_income, levels = income_order)]
setorder(income_averted_all, location_income)

# ---- BOD summary scalars (All Interventions) ---------------------------------
bod_all <- bod_tab1[intervention == "All Interventions"]
total_ylls_all  <- bod_all$YLLs
total_ylds_all  <- bod_all$YLDs
total_dalys_all <- bod_all$DALYs

bod_bp <- bod_tab1[intervention == "HTN Control (No Diabetes)"]
total_dalys_bp <- bod_bp$DALYs

bod_stat <- bod_tab1[intervention == "Improved Statin Uptake"]
total_dalys_stat <- bod_stat$DALYs

bod_bpd <- bod_tab1[intervention == "HTN Control (Diabetes)"]
total_dalys_bpd <- bod_bpd$DALYs

# ---- Save comprehensive paper scalar bundle ----------------------------------
paper_scalars <- list(
  # Core counts
  n_countries      = n_countries,
  study_years      = study_years,
  bau_total_deaths = bau_total_deaths,
  total_all        = total_all,
  total_bp         = total_bp,
  total_bpd        = total_bpd,
  total_stat       = total_stat,

  # Percentages of BAU
  pct_all  = pct_all,
  pct_bp   = pct_bp,
  pct_bpd  = pct_bpd,
  pct_stat = pct_stat,

  # Annual deaths averted at key years
  annual_2030_all  = annual_2030_all,
  annual_2050_all  = annual_2050_all,
  annual_2030_bp   = annual_2030_bp,
  annual_2050_bp   = annual_2050_bp,
  annual_2030_stat = annual_2030_stat,
  annual_2050_stat = annual_2050_stat,

  # Cause-specific (All Interventions)
  averted_ihd_all     = cause_averted_all[cause == "ihd",     averted],
  averted_istroke_all = cause_averted_all[cause == "istroke", averted],
  averted_hstroke_all = cause_averted_all[cause == "hstroke", averted],
  averted_hhd_all     = cause_averted_all[cause == "hhd",     averted],

  # Cause-specific (HTN General)
  averted_ihd_bp     = cause_averted_bp[cause == "ihd",     averted],
  averted_istroke_bp = cause_averted_bp[cause == "istroke", averted],
  averted_hstroke_bp = cause_averted_bp[cause == "hstroke", averted],
  averted_hhd_bp     = cause_averted_bp[cause == "hhd",     averted],

  # Cause-specific (Statins)
  averted_ihd_stat     = cause_averted_stat[cause == "ihd",     averted],
  averted_istroke_stat = cause_averted_stat[cause == "istroke", averted],

  # Age-group (All Interventions)
  averted_lt70  = age_averted_all[age_group == "<70",   averted],
  averted_70_79 = age_averted_all[age_group == "70-79", averted],
  averted_80_89 = age_averted_all[age_group == "80-89", averted],
  averted_90p   = age_averted_all[age_group == "90+",   averted],

  # Sex (All Interventions)
  averted_male   = sex_averted_all[sex == "Male",   averted],
  averted_female = sex_averted_all[sex == "Female", averted],

  # BOD summary
  total_ylls_all  = total_ylls_all,
  total_ylds_all  = total_ylds_all,
  total_dalys_all = total_dalys_all,
  total_dalys_bp  = total_dalys_bp,
  total_dalys_stat = total_dalys_stat,
  total_dalys_bpd  = total_dalys_bpd,

  # Top 5 countries
  top5_names   = top5_countries$location,
  top5_averted = top5_countries$deaths_delayed,

  # Region totals (All Interventions)
  region_tab = dt_tab5[, .(region, deaths_delayed, deaths_delayed_pct)],

  # Income group totals
  income_tab = income_averted_all
)

saveRDS(paper_scalars, paste0(paper_dir, "paper_scalars.rds"))
message("Paper scalars saved: paper_scalars.rds")
```
